Hello guys!

We listen to you! And we are happy to announce a few changes to make everyone's experiences more comfy and relaxing! Here is the list of improvements:

[list]
[*] Added a button in the menu to empty the bottom box completely
[*] Added a button to show only the puzzle edges (or you can do it by pressing B)
[*] Added an option to drag pieces without keeping the mouse button pressed (one click grabs, one click drops)
[*] Added a button to clean all the pieces in the board
[*] Now the shuffle button only shuffles the pieces outside the board
[*] Now you can move a piece out of the box with the mouse middle button or Ctrl
[/list]

That's it! Please enjoy it and if you have more suggestions let us know in the discussion forums!

notes.title: About DLCs and SJP games
notes.content:
Hi guys!

We've been taking in consideration the suggestion of one of our players (thanks Falcon!) about giving you the DLCs of the original SJP games if you own the original games.

After some research we found an easy way to do it so from today, the owners of the original games should have the correspondent DLCs in their Steam accounts.

Thank you for you support and keep making puzzles!

notes.title: Adjusting the game
notes.content:
Hi there!

It's been a few days after the launch of Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations. Throughout this time we have been studying the behavior of our players and have found that the price in game coins to unlock the puzzles it's probably too high, and could be a bit frustrating for some people. 

With the last update we have reduce that price to the half, from 3000 to 1500 coins. All those who have already unlocked any puzzle will receive the difference back in their coin account.


We hope you like this change.

Thanks for playing!
